children: Russia raises 2026 gross domestic product (GDP) growth forecast to 0.6% from 0.4% previously, Russian state TV quoted Economy Minister Maxim Reshetnikov as saying on Wednesday.

Russia’s economy ministry in May has sharply downgraded its macroeconomic forecasts for 2026–2029, anticipating a slowdown in gross domestic product growth, industrial output, capital investment, real disposable incomes and weaker consumer activity after more than four years of war in Ukraine.
